Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest to the sister’s children who reach 25 can vest too remotely under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, so it is void and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s word “hitherto” limits the aphorism to past progressive societies, but it is commonly misread as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: Immediate post-operative care requires continuous urine-output measurement, so a catheter valve is not used then; the other options are reasons a valve may be used.
